design.name: 蝎尾弩卫
design.brief: A scorpion-centaur archer: the upper body of a veiled desert huntress (face hidden by a gold-coin veil, glowing white-gold eyes, Dunhuang-style jewellery, bronze arm bracers) joined at the waist to the body of a giant dark red desert scorpion with eight segmented legs and two big pincers. Its curled scorpion tail ends in a built-in bronze crossbow instead of a stinger, with a swollen glowing white-gold venom sac at the tail base (weak spot). Human hands with a clearly separate thumb and four separate fingers.
design.weapon: the tail crossbow aimed over its head
